scripts.dev: PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)"):$PATH" tauri dev --features devtools,dev-bridge
scripts.dev:web:api: PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)"):$PATH" cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features dev-bridge --example dev_server
scripts.test:rust: PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)"):$PATH" cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1
scripts.audit:cargo: cd src-tauri && PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)"):$PATH" cargo audit
scripts.tauri:build: CI=true PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which rustc)"):$PATH" tauri build
scripts.release:check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:rust && npm run audit && npm run audit:cargo
